I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It runs correctly under `wj run --interpret` on a test I built from Example 1 plus a few error cases.

That run covered the success paths, `unknown account`, `same account`, `invalid amount` on a negative `open` and `insufficient funds`. The final sorted listing came out right. I did not run Example 2 itself, and I did not test the `duplicate account` error.
